scripts.dev:electron: npx wait-on http://localhost:5173 file:backend/dist/main.js && electron electron/dist/main.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "FE,BE_BUILD,ELE_BUILD,ELE" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run build:backend:watch" "npm run build:electron:watch" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:electron
scripts.ready: npm i --prefix frontend && npm i --prefix backend && npm i --prefix electron && npm i
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run rebuild && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
